init_bert_encoder: create a HuggingFaceBertSentenceEncoder instance with a config and output_encoded_layers flag
encode_sentence_with_bert: encode input tokens using the BERT model via the _encoder method returning encoded layers and pooled output
load_bert_weights: load pre-trained BERT weights from a pytorch_model.bin file with LayerNorm key compatibility handling
get_bert_word_embeddings: get the BERT word embeddings tensor via the _embedding method for weight tying in MaskedLM
review_bert_config: review the HuggingFaceBertSentenceEncoder Config class with bert_cpt_dir and load_weights settings
